summary: Iter41: Super admin 'Monitor de Vapi'. Only read-only checks: GET endpoints and UI, no repair, reconfigure or Vapi writes. Backend 13/13 pass: the 4 endpoints reject no-auth and non-admin with 401/403; the shapes of calls/errors/spend/numbers are right; spend days are sorted ascending and owners by cost descending; errors contain only level=error rows and no _id; numbers ok == !issues; reason() mapping unit tests pass. UI 100%: the sidebar item 'Monitor de Vapi' goes to /app/vapi; all 4 tabs render (100 calls; Numbers tab says '1 con fallo' with the expected stale-id issues for +34919932652; Errors (10) list; spend total $4.30 with per-day and per-client bars); filters work (entrante 48 + saliente 52 = 100, error 10, aviso 21, all 100); the Actualizar button updates vapi-updated-at; auto-refresh fires within 15s; no page errors. Regression: the agent editor General tab still shows reception-panel. /app/lineas renders, but GET /api/admin/lines returns 424 in preview because Zadarma is not configured, so the table stays on 'Cargando…'. This is environmental and existed before.

minor.issue: Some codes get the wrong label. 'call.in-progress.sip-completed-call' (likely a normal SIP hangup) is shown as error 'Fallo de la línea telefónica'. 'call.in-progress.error-transfer-failed' is shown as 'Fallo de voz o IA' when it should say 'No se pudo pasar la llamada'. Consider adding explicit mappings for transfer-failed and sip-completed-call.

audit() is not cached. It calls Vapi /credential and /phone-number (and Zadarma when configured) on every request, and the UI polls every 15s per open tab. Risk of hitting rate limits on the shared production Vapi account. Suggest a 15-30s _cached like calls/spend.

ui_bugs.issue: When GET /api/admin/lines fails (424 because Zadarma is not configured), only a toast appears and the page keeps showing 'Cargando…' with no error state. Existed before.

integration_issues.issue: Promise.all over 4 endpoints: if one fails (e.g. a Vapi credential error in numbers), none of the tabs update. Consider Promise.allSettled.

issues: The 'Cliente' column wraps 'Sin asignar en VozLeads' onto 2 lines
The 'COSTE' and 'CÓMO TERMINÓ' headers and the cells next to them have no horizontal padding, so they run together (e.g. '—$0.000', 'COSTE CÓMO TERMINÓ'). Add px-2 to th/td.

action_items: Add reason mappings for transfer-failed and sip-completed-call (sip-completed-call should probably not be an error)
Cache audit() for 15-30s to avoid hammering Vapi every 15s
Add cell padding in the Vapi calls table; widen or no-wrap the owner column
Optional: Promise.allSettled in AdminVapi.load; error state in AdminLines when the load fails
critical_code_review_comments: The numbers audit is uncached while the UI polls every 15s (shared production Vapi account)
reason() falls back to substring matching ('sip', 'error'), so benign codes containing 'sip' get flagged as errors
A failure in one endpoint blocks all tabs (Promise.all)
seed_data_creation: One TEST_VM non-admin user (test_vm_*@example.com) registered for the 403 test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Never call repair-inbound/reconfigure/move/disconnect: Vapi is shared with production. Run tests with the backend .env loaded and -n0 to see prints.
